mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lag_snapshot (topic, lag, level, sampled_at) VALUES (#{topic}, #{lag}, #{level}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT topic AS "topic", lag AS "lag", level AS "level", sampled_at AS "sampledAt" FROM lag_snapshot ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_rule (name, target, field, type, params_json, enabled, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{target}, #{field}, #{type}, #{paramsJson}, #{enabled}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE quality_rule SET target = #{target}, field = #{field}, type = #{type}, params_json = #{paramsJson}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = #{name}
mapper.select: SELECT name AS "name", target AS "target", field AS "field", type AS "type", params_json AS "paramsJson", enabled AS "enabled" FROM quality_rule WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT name AS "name", target AS "target", field AS "field", type AS "type", params_json AS "paramsJson", enabled AS "enabled" FROM quality_rule ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_result (rule_name, pass, checked, violated, samples_json, ran_at) VALUES (#{ruleName}, #{pass}, #{checked}, #{violated}, #{samplesJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT rule_name AS "ruleName", pass AS "pass", checked AS "checked", violated AS "violated", samples_json AS "samplesJson", ran_at AS "ranAt" FROM quality_result ORDER BY ran_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO backfill_job (job_id, name, range_start, range_end, shard_count, completed_json, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{name}, #{rangeStart}, #{rangeEnd}, #{shardCount}, #{completedJson}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT job_id AS "jobId", name AS "name", range_start AS "rangeStart", range_end AS "rangeEnd", shard_count AS "shardCount", completed_json AS "completedJson", status AS "status" FROM backfill_job WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_miss (task, expected_ms, actual_ms, overdue_ms, detected_at) VALUES (#{task}, #{expectedMs}, #{actualMs}, #{overdueMs}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT task AS "task", expected_ms AS "expectedMs", actual_ms AS "actualMs", overdue_ms AS "overdueMs", detected_at AS "detectedAt" FROM sla_miss ORDER BY detected_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
